role_name: Software Engineer #2 (核心领域服务、算法与业务状态机 (Core Domain Services & Algorithms))
content:
### Implementation Summary: Module 2 (核心领域服务、算法与业务状态机)

All assigned domain services, algorithms, business state machines, and core algorithm unit tests have been completely implemented and verified with 100% test pass rate.

---

### Files Implemented

1. [`soulred/services/__init__.py`](file:///Users/chz/workspace/auto-agent/workspaces/trust_social_app/soulred/services/__init__.py)
   - Unified export of all domain services: [`AuthService`](file:///Users/chz/workspace/auto-agent/workspaces/trust_social_app/soulred/services/auth_service.py), [`ContentSafetyService`](file:///Users/chz/workspace/auto-agent/workspaces/trust_social_app/soulred/services/safety_service.py), [`PostService`](file:///Users/chz/workspace/auto-agent/workspaces/trust_social_app/soulred/services/post_service.py), [`FeedService`](file:///Users/chz/workspace/auto-agent/workspaces/trust_social_app/soulred/services/feed_service.py), [`MatchingService`](file:///Users/chz/workspace/auto-agent/workspaces/trust_social_app/soulred/services/matching_service.py), [`ChatService`](file:///Users/chz/workspace/auto-agent/workspaces/trust_social_app/soulred/services/chat_service.py), and [`CircleService`](file:///Users/chz/workspace/auto-agent/workspaces/trust_social_app/soulred/services/circle_service.py).

2. [`soulred/services/safety_service.py`](file:///Users/chz/workspace/auto-agent/workspaces/trust_social_app/soulred/services/safety_service.py)
   - AI multimodal & text risk control service.
   - Implements multi-category sensitive word detection (politics, pornography, scam, violence) with regex character masking.
   - Distinguishes immediate rejection (`REJECTED`) from suspicious patterns escalated for manual review (`PENDING_REVIEW`).
   - Implements simulated multimodal image safety checks and composite post review (`review_post_content`).

3. [`soulred/services/auth_service.py`](file:///Users/chz/workspace/auto-agent/workspaces/trust_social_app/soulred/services/auth_service.py)
   - User security and authentication service.
   - User registration with bcrypt password hashing and AES-256-GCM encrypted PII storage (mobile number, real name, ID card).
   - Credential authentication, token issuance, QingTeng-style authenticity verification submissions (`submit_verification`).
   - Granular privacy protection (`apply_privacy_filters`) supporting Haversine distance computation, coordinate masking, and incognito controls.

4. [`soulred/services/post_service.py`](file:///Users/chz/workspace/auto-agent/workspaces/trust_social_app/soulred/services/post_service.py)
   - Xiaohongshu-style rich note publishing service.
   - Integrated AI content safety filtering, multi-image attachment handling (up to 9 images, aspect ratio, blurhash).
   - Local draft auto-save and restoration (`save_draft`, `get_draft`).
   - Atomic note like toggling (`toggle_like`) and immersive post detail view assembly (`get_post_detail`).

5. [`soulred/services/feed_service.py`](file:///Users/chz/workspace/auto-agent/workspaces/trust_social_app/soulred/services/feed_service.py)
   - Xiaohongshu-style dual-column waterfall layout & multi-channel ranking engine.
   - Zero-CLS aspect ratio pre-calculation (`calculate_card_aspect_ratio` for 1:1, 3:4, 4:3) and skeleton color tagging.
   - Multi-channel sorting:
     - `recommend`: Heat-decay composite scoring ($Score = (Likes \times 2 + Comments \times 3 + Views \times 0.1) \times \frac{1}{1 + \Delta t \times 0.05}$).
     - `nearby`: Spherical Haversine distance-based proximity ranking.
     - `following`: Reverse chronological timeline.

6. [`soulred/services/matching_service.py`](file:///Users/chz/workspace/auto-agent/workspaces/trust_social_app/soulred/services/matching_service.py)
   - Soul & QingTeng matching and recommendation engine.
   - Multidimensional personality & values vector cosine similarity algorithm (`calculate_soul_similarity`) with MBTI golden-pair synergy bonuses.
   - Soul Radar discovery filtering active users with $\ge 80\%$ similarity.
   - QingTeng-style daily recommendation cards (`generate_daily_recommendations`).
   - Bidirectional crush state machine (`handle_crush_action`): triggers `MUTUAL` double-crush event and automatically initializes the dedicated private chat channel and intimacy record.
   - Stranger anti-harassment quota (`check_stranger_message_limit`): strict limit of 1 text message per day, zero voice/images for strangers.

7. [`soulred/services/chat_service.py`](file:///Users/chz/workspace/auto-agent/workspaces/trust_social_app/soulred/services/chat_service.py)
   - Real-time instant messaging business service.
   - Smart icebreaker topic generator (`generate_icebreakers`) based on shared interest tags and MBTI synergies.
   - Soul intimacy tree progression state machine (`calculate_intimacy_gain`): tracks daily interaction days, daily word count anti-cheat caps, and advances levels (`初识萌芽` $\rightarrow$ `渐入佳境` $\rightarrow$ `无话不谈` $\rightarrow$ `挚友星辰`).
   - Strict 2-minute message recall validation (`recall_message`) and conversation history retrieval with automatic unread clearance.

8. [`soulred/services/circle_service.py`](file:///Users/chz/workspace/auto-agent/workspaces/trust_social_app/soulred/services/circle_service.py)
   - Thematic interest circles and community interaction service.
   - Circle discovery and member join/mute management.
   - Multi-tier threaded comment submission with pre-check for mute status and sensitive content.
   - Recursive comment tree building algorithm (`build_comment_tree`) with hot-pinned comment prioritization and chronological reply ordering.
   - Content moderation actions (`moderate_content`: delete, mute, ban).

9. [`tests/test_services.py`](file:///Users/chz/workspace/auto-agent/workspaces/trust_social_app/tests/test_services.py)
   - Comprehensive test suite covering all architecture-required test symbols:
     - `test_soul_similarity_calc`
     - `test_waterfall_card_aspect_ratio`
     - `test_intimacy_xp_progression`
     - `test_safety_keyword_interception`
     - `test_stranger_greeting_quota`
     - Plus full service flow tests (Auth, Post, Feed, Matching, Chat, Circles).
   - **Test Results**: **12 passed, 0 failed** in 2.95s.
